title: Claude with web search narrates before its JSON, so a strict JSON parser reports nothing
symptoms: JSON.parse fails or returns an empty list
Report says zero items checked although the model answered
cause: With web search on, the model writes prose before the JSON array. A parser that demands the whole reply be JSON discards a correct answer, which then reads like a clean result.
fix: Find the first { or [ in the reply, walk forward counting bracket depth while skipping string contents and escaped characters, and parse the slice that closes at depth zero. Fail loudly if none is found.
apply: function firstJson(t) { const s = t.search(/[[{]/); if (s < 0) throw new Error('no JSON'); let depth = 0, inStr = false, esc = false; for (let i = s; i < t.length; i++) { const c = t[i]; if (inStr) { if (esc) esc = false; else if (c === '\\') esc = true; else if (c === '"') inStr = false; continue; } if (c === '"') inStr = true; else if (c === '[' || c === '{') depth++; else if ((c === ']' || c === '}') && --depth === 0) return JSON.parse(t.slice(s, i + 1)); } throw new Error('unclosed JSON'); }
affected: Claude with the web search tool, September 2026
